tagline: A regional bank providing comprehensive financial services including lending, deposits, and treasury management
hero_kpi_rationale: Key profitability indicator for shareholders, reflecting the ability to generate returns on tangible equity.

kpis.name: Pre-provision net revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues less operating expenses, before provisions for loan losses.
kpis.description: Key banking performance indicator reflecting profitability before credit risk.

kpis.name: Net income attributable to common shareholders
kpis.explanation: Net income after taxes and preferred dividends, available to common shareholders.
kpis.description: Reflection of overall group performance after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.signal: Significant rebound in net income in 2025
kpis.name_en: Net income attributable to common shareholders

kpis.name: Tangible common equity
kpis.explanation: Common equity after deduction of goodwill and intangible assets.
kpis.description: Measure of financial strength excluding intangible assets.

kpis.name: Tangible assets
kpis.explanation: Total assets less goodwill and intangible assets.
kpis.description: Real productive asset base of the bank.

kpis.name: Return on tangible common equity
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by average tangible common equity, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Key performance indicator for shareholders reflecting capital deployment efficiency.

kpis.name: Book value per share
kpis.explanation: Common equity divided by number of shares outstanding.
kpis.signal: Growth in book value per share

kpis.short: Tangible Book Value per Common Share
kpis.name: Tangible book value per share
kpis.explanation: Tangible common equity divided by number of shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Stricter measure of value per share excluding intangible assets.
kpis.signal: Growth in tangible book value per share

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $3.419 billion in last fiscal year (FY2025)

kpis.name: Dividends per share
kpis.description: Annual dividends per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 reported fiscal years by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividends per share of $0.17 in last year

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Dividend payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 reported fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 34.6% in last year

risks.title: Preferred dividends take priority
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned first in Item 1A, with binding language (must pay). It directly affects the ability to pay common dividends or repurchase shares, which may discourage investors. The absolute priority of preferred dividends creates significant financial pressure in case of liquidity difficulties. The Capital category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Regulatory barriers to acquisition
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes multiple layers of restrictions (Tennessee law, federal regulatory approval, statutory provisions). Language clearly indicates a deterrent effect on takeovers, even if advantageous. This risk is stable but critical as it may block major strategic opportunities. The Regulation category is heavily impacted.

risks.title: Exclusive forum provisions limiting remedies
risks.score_rationale: The risk is described with precise language on limitations of legal remedies. Although the text mentions uncertainty regarding application to federal law, provisions are binding. This may deter litigation but also expose the company to governance criticism. The Litigation category is moderately weighted.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: A dedicated item (Item 1C) is included in the 10-K, demonstrating increased risk recognition. Although details are incorporated by reference, creation of a specific section indicates high intensity. In 2025, this risk is strategic for financial institutions. The Cybersecurity category is heavily weighted.

risks.title: Dependence on executive management
risks.score_rationale: Employment of D. Bryan Jordan is governed by a contract through 2028, with a waiver retirement policy. Concentration of power on a single individual, particularly President, CEO, and Chairman, creates governance risk. Language is neutral but facts are significant. The Key Person category is moderately weighted.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence in the report.
